name: ApplyScenario

parameters.help_en:
The scenario where you want to use the business monitoring job. Valid values:

`USER-DEFINED`: user-defined. This is the default value.
`EDAS-ROLLOUT`: application release in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
`OAM-ROLLOUT`: application release based on Open Application Model (OAM)
`MSC-CANARY`: canary release based on Microservice Engine (MSE)
parameters.help_zh:
使用场景。选项：

`USER-DEFINED`（默认）：用户自定义。
`EDAS-ROLLOUT`：EDAS应用发布。
`OAM-ROLLOUT`：OAM应用发布。
`MSC-CANARY`：MSE金丝雀发布
parameters.name: scenario

parameters.help_en: The name of the business monitoring job
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The code of the business monitoring job. This parameter is not required when you create a business monitoring job. However, this parameter is required when you update a business monitoring job
parameters.help_zh: 场景编码。新建业务监控时无需设置，更新业务监控时必须设置
parameters.name: sign

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the business monitoring job. The value is a JSON string. For more information about this parameter, see the following additional information about the Config parameter
parameters.help_zh: 业务监控配置JSON字段。关于此字段的详细说明参见下文关于参数Config的补充说明
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the coloring sign is transparently passed down to downstream application nodes in the trace.

`true`
`false`: This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
染色标是否向下透传。

`true`
`false`（默认）
parameters.name: sn_transfer

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to count traffic based on the coloring sign.

`true`
`false`: This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
染色标是否统计流量。
`true`
`false`（默认）
parameters.name: sn_stat

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record business parameters to the trace marked with the coloring sign.

`true`
`false`: This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
染色标的链路是否Dump业务参数。
`true`
`false`（默认）
parameters.name: sn_dump

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether traffic in the trace marked with the coloring sign is all collected.

`true`
`false`: This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
染色标的链路是否全量采集。
`true`
`false`（默认）
parameters.name: sn_force

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the operation is an update operation.

`true`: update
`false`: insert
parameters.help_zh:
是否更新操作。

`true`：更新操作。
`false`：插入操作
parameters.name: update_option

Result.description_en: The code of the business monitoring job, which is the coloring sign
